rationales.LC: Attacker language enters as a fetched MCP tool manifest, including the send_email description, and is given to the model unpinned and unscanned; it is not a direct user prompt and is not reduced to closed validated fields.
rationales.CP: The manifest is fetched on every run and the shadowing is an in-run name replacement; that is re-retrieval of remote source content, not a write into the durable notes store that later sessions treat as trusted.
rationales.AP: The lab documents one agent and no handoffs; manifest load, tool-list replacement, model tool_use, and harness dispatch stay under that single identity and do not enter another agent, tenant, or policy domain.
rationales.RH: The in-repo proof is a scripted-model test that one email is sent under the name send_email; the packet has no evaluator, verifier, or reward channel on this path and no isolation test or production-equivalent reward-hacking episode.
rationales.ES: Remote MCP tools are dynamic and trusted on each run, a colliding name replaces the built-in, and baseline arguments and schemas are not independently constrained outside model output.

score.automatable_rationale: The documented impact needs a caller-attached attacker MCP server, which the default CLI does not attach, and a user request that causes send_email to be invoked. The attacker cannot finish the diversion without that human request.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The demonstrated effect is diversion of the recipient, subject, and body of send_email calls to the remote server, not total control of the agent or disclosure of every resource it holds.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: The default runtime calls an Anthropic model that chooses tools, arguments, and order across up to ten turns, and the harness executes that selection. Hardening is empty; an MCP client is used only when a caller passes one, and on that path the same model-directed loop dispatches the shadowed send_email.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models the office assistant as a model-directed loop that selects and sequences tools. It states scripted models exist only in tests and the replay demo, not as the modeled default agent.
